statements.query: SELECT "t0"."id", "t0"."name", "t0"."email", "t0"."created_at" AS "createdAt", "User_posts"."__prisma_data__" AS "posts" FROM "public"."users" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COALESCE(JSONB_AGG("__prisma_data__"), '[]') AS "__prisma_data__" FROM (SELECT "t3"."__prisma_data__" FROM (SELECT JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('id', "t2"."id", 'title', "t2"."title", 'body', "t2"."body", 'createdAt', "t2"."created_at", 'comments', "Post_comments"."__prisma_data__") AS "__prisma_data__", "t2"."id" FROM (SELECT "t1".* FROM "public"."posts" AS "t1" WHERE "t0"."id" = "t1"."user_id" /* root select */) AS "t2" LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COALESCE(JSONB_AGG("__prisma_data__"), '[]') AS "__prisma_data__" FROM (SELECT "t7"."__prisma_data__" FROM (SELECT JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('id', "t6"."id", 'author', "t6"."author", 'body', "t6"."body", 'createdAt', "t6"."created_at") AS "__prisma_data__", "t6"."id" FROM (SELECT "t5".* FROM "public"."comments" AS "t5" WHERE "t2"."id" = "t5"."post_id" /* root select */) AS "t6" /* inner select */) AS "t7" ORDER BY "t7"."id" ASC /* middle select */) AS "t8" /* outer select */) AS "Post_comments" ON true /* inner select */) AS "t3" ORDER BY "t3"."id" ASC /* middle select */) AS "t4" /* outer select */) AS "User_posts" ON true WHERE ("t0"."id" = $1 AND 1=1) LIMIT $2
